figurative_meaning_en: Smuggling goods by evading customs duties
example_sentences_in_bangla: সীমান্ত অঞ্চলে চোরাচালানের ঘটনা প্রায়ই ঘটে।
পুলিশ চোরাচালান রোধে কঠোর পদক্ষেপ নিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Smuggling incidents often occur in border areas.
The police have taken strict measures to curb smuggling.
note: This idiom is widely used in contexts involving cross-border trade in Bengali-speaking regions like Bangladesh and West Bengal.
